## Release 1.16.0 was not published

`v1.16.0` (7943e0e) was tagged and its hallway image
`ghcr.io/living-proof-labs/capability-verifier-hallway:1.16.0` was built and passed the native
per-arch 12/20 check, but the release stayed a draft with no assets: after a "re-run failed jobs",
release-reports looked for the report artifact under the re-run's attempt number and did not find
it. 1.16.1 carries the same verifier code plus that workflow fix. Use 1.16.1 (index digest below).
